model_meta.description: Concept model of the base-jaw/top-jaw implement clamping arrangement and the disclosed jaw-exchange interaction. Optional locking-bolt and spring-loaded inhibiting retention variants are outside the represented model scope.

subsystems.description: Jaw component with plug connector and positioning surfaces. Optional locking-bolt and spring-loaded inhibiting retention variants are outside the represented model scope.
Replaceable jaw with complementary plug feature, positioning surface and clamping surface for a tool or workpiece.
External item held by the top-jaw clamping surface.
Machine-level device that aligns and exchanges top jaws relative to base jaws.

item_flows.name: Jaw plug-in displacement
item_flows.notes: Relative displacement along the rectilinear plug-in path.

item_flows.name: Jaw exchange motion
item_flows.notes: Device positions top jaws for attachment or removal.

requirements.statement: The plug-connector wedge angle is at least 85° and at most 140°.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1 specifies the angle range; the description associates it with reduced jamming and easier engagement/separation.

steps.description: Bring the opposed end-face positioning surfaces into contact while the wedge rib and slot are radially apart.
Displace the jaws along the plug-in path so the rib enters the slot and the reciprocal slot-rim features engage; oblique surfaces limit engagement depth and draw positioning surfaces together.
Apply clamping through the top-jaw clamping surface to hold a tool or workpiece.
Align the top jaw relative to the base jaw using the jaw exchanging device.
Move the jaws relative to one another to plug together or disengage along the disclosed positioning and plug-in motions.
